# Vendored Waline Core

This directory contains the bundled CommonJS output of `@waline/core` 0.1.0
from commit `201cb21938efdb96a0c2665c01764346ad1ea68e` of
<https://github.com/walinejs/waline>. The package was not yet available from
the npm registry when this integration was created.

Waline Core is licensed under the MIT License. Copyright belongs to the
Waline contributors. Replace this vendored build with the published package
once `@waline/core` is available without changing the adapter contract.
